prompts.text: A standard die shows 4. Is the opposite face higher or lower than 4?

The Burj Khalifa is the tallest building. Is it higher or lower than 1 km?

Is the speed of sound higher or lower than 1,000 km/h?
Is the number of keys on a standard piano higher or lower than 80?
Is the number of bones in an adult human higher or lower than 250?
Is the number of countries in the world higher or lower than 150?
Is Earth's circumference at the equator higher or lower than 50,000 km?
Is the number of moons orbiting Saturn higher or lower than 80?
Is the number of letters in the English alphabet higher or lower than 30?
Is the boiling point of water higher or lower than 150°C?
Is the number of stars on the US flag higher or lower than 45?
Is the top speed of a cheetah higher or lower than 100 km/h?
